reason: Complete HTML full text (body, 8 tables, appendix A-C) read; no GitHub code run. Scope A-type: LLM-generated/updated Skills (LoadDataSchema+Prompt) and a distilled knowledge base persist and are re-read in later O&M events.

paper.central_claim: A unified self-evolving mechanism lets one practitioner feedback signal drive two parallel pathways (memory-to-knowledge distillation and targeted Skill refinement) so that the knowledge base and event-to-(data,knowledge) mapping co-evolve; deployed on Kuaishou e-commerce search it cuts alerts 75%, reaches 80% RCA accuracy, halves MTTR and passes 99.0% of 104 offline cases.
paper.title: Bian Que: An Agentic Framework with Flexible Skill Arrangement for Online System Operations

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref not exposed to the worker; null by contract.

evidence.quote: reduces alert volume by 75%, achieves 80% root-cause analysis accuracy, cuts mean time to resolution by over 50%, and attains a 99.0% pass rate on offline evaluations.
evidence.support_explanation: Headline claim; author-reported production and offline numbers.

evidence.quote: Hence, the core challenge is not reasoning capability, but the contextual selection of appropriate data and knowledge for each operational event.
evidence.support_explanation: Author-stated gap: context assembly (event -> data+knowledge), not reasoning.

evidence.quote: The generated Skill is then validated by executing its LoadDataSchema against the triggering event; if any specified source fails to return the expected fields, the error is fed back to the LLM for regeneration, up to three retries.
evidence.support_explanation: Only automatic gate on a new Skill is that its data-loading schema executes and returns the expected fields; it does not test diagnostic correctness.

evidence.quote: The framework then revises the appropriate component of the Skill—adjusting LoadDataSchema if the agent missed a critical data source or knowledge entry, or adjusting the Prompt if the agent retrieved adequate information but reasoned over it incorrectly.
evidence.support_explanation: Failure attribution to retrieval vs reasoning defect and localized Skill edit triggered by practitioner natural-language feedback.

evidence.quote: A daily offline process deduplicates and prunes the knowledge base to resolve accumulated contradictions and prevent unbounded growth; corrections take effect immediately through the short-term case memory and need not wait for this cycle.
evidence.support_explanation: Maintenance/forgetting of distilled knowledge; no admission test for new knowledge entries and no measured effect of the pruning.

evidence.quote: selects relevant Skills via keyword matching against event metadata
evidence.support_explanation: Next-round read path for Skills is keyword tag matching.

evidence.quote: We qualitatively observe this compounding effect in deployment; a controlled quantitative measurement is left to future work, as it requires a longer horizon than our current six-month deployment permits.
evidence.support_explanation: The co-evolution (knowledge x Skill compounding) claim is explicitly not measured.

evidence.quote: Online production deployment results over a six-month window, comparing the month preceding Bian Que rollout to the six-month post-rollout period.
evidence.support_explanation: Online KPI evidence is a pre/post comparison (1 month vs 6 months), no concurrent control.

evidence.quote: The 75% drop in fired alerts is primarily driven by release interception and proactive inspection, which resolve problems before they breach alert thresholds.
evidence.support_explanation: Author attributes the headline alert reduction to the paradigm/agents, not to the self-evolving mechanism.

evidence.quote: we curate 104 real operational events sampled from production logs—44 alerts and 60 inspections—each annotated with a ground-truth diagnosis by senior site reliability engineers (SREs).
evidence.support_explanation: Offline benchmark: author-curated, 104 events, SRE ground truth; annotator count/agreement not reported.

evidence.quote: times and counts it as passed if at least one run produces a correct Skill yielding the ground-truth diagnosis.
evidence.support_explanation: Pass@k credits an event if any of k samples works, a lenient oracle-selected metric not equal to single-run deployment behaviour.

evidence.quote: the Skill directory is reset to a clean seed state before the run, so that Skills from prior evaluation runs do not leak into the current run.
evidence.support_explanation: Skill-level leakage control exists; knowledge-base / case-memory state before offline runs is not described.

evidence.quote: falls from 94.2% to 83.7%
evidence.support_explanation: Static (manually authored, no LLM generate/update) Skills vs full: pass@5 94.2 -> 83.7 on 104 events.
NoKnow (case memory + distilled knowledge off) pass@5 94.2 -> 86.5.

evidence.quote: We asked senior SREs to provide targeted natural-language corrections for the six cases that failed at pass@
evidence.support_explanation: The 99.0% headline offline number is obtained after SRE corrections targeted at the cases that failed on this same evaluation set (oracle-selected, selection set = test set).

evidence.quote: we deployed the feedback pathway on production traffic for a 13-day controlled experiment
evidence.support_explanation: Only feedback-on vs feedback-off contrast on later traffic; result shown in Fig.4, text gives approximate values only (no n per day, no interval).

evidence.quote: With the feedback pathway enabled, the system continuously distills failure cases into new Skills and knowledge, and accuracy remains consistently above 80% throughout the 13 days.
evidence.support_explanation: Retention-flavoured result: on-arm stays >80%, off-arm (frozen) declines; supervision is practitioner feedback.

evidence.quote: the majority of incorrect diagnoses stem from insufficient domain knowledge for newly deployed services
evidence.support_explanation: Author-reported failure analysis; no failure taxonomy table or counts.

evidence.quote: The default LLM backbone is Qwen3.5-35B-FP8 deployed on a single NVIDIA Tesla L20 GPU.
evidence.support_explanation: Only compute statement; no tokens/calls per event, no cost of generation/update/retry loops.

evidence.quote: is positioned one step earlier in the pipeline, responsible for selecting the right data and knowledge before any diagnostic reasoning happens.
evidence.support_explanation: Nearest-neighbour positioning vs RCAgent-style reasoners; no experimental comparison to any neighbour.

evidence.quote: the alert RCA agent classifies and suppresses non-actionable alerts rather than paging practitioners.
evidence.support_explanation: Alert suppression is a headline benefit but no recall/missed-incident check is reported (absence searched in Sec 3.2, Table 2, Appendix C).

evidence.quote: : Skills are manually authored and fixed, disabling LLM-driven generation and update.
evidence.support_explanation: Static baseline definition; provenance, authors and effort of the manual Skills are not given, so it tests LLM generation more than evolution over time.

gap.author_gap: LLM O&M agents assume a curated context; real bottleneck is selecting event-specific data and knowledge, and hand-maintaining the mapping is intractable under dozens of releases a day.
gap.checked_gap: Concrete and practical (context assembly for O&M; static Skill pool versus drifting traffic), but the 'dilution/hallucination from feeding all signals' premise is asserted, not measured against an all-signals baseline; closest neighbours (RCAgent, self-evolving memory systems, skill-library agents) are cited rather than compared.
gap.lineage: AIOps anomaly/RCA pipelines -> LLM RCA agents (RCAgent) -> memory/skill-evolving agents; this paper adds LLM-generated/updated data-routing Skills plus feedback-driven knowledge distillation.
gap.closest_adjacent: RCAgent-type reasoners (which could plug in as f_LLM) and single-pathway self-evolving memory work [39-41]; skill-library agents are not discussed by name in the read text.
gap.residue: Event-to-context mapping drifts as systems change; static mapping loses accuracy (author's 13-day frozen arm).
gap.stakes: Pager load and MTTR for ~100 engineers; author reports 80% of fired alerts non-actionable pre-deployment.
gap.method_response: Skills as editable context-assembly units + feedback routed to Skill vs knowledge pathway.
gap.remaining_gap: Quantified benefit of the two-pathway coupling, autonomy without human feedback, regression safety of Skill edits, comparison with other context-assembly or memory baselines.
gap.unresolved: Whether LLM-only (no human) feedback would sustain accuracy; relative value vs strong RAG/all-signals baseline.

rs_pattern.reason: Event solved at inference by assembling retrieved data+knowledge into the prompt (conditioning), no weight updates; agent x Skill decomposition with executable, schema-checked artifact is the secondary operation.

matches.tactic_steps_checked: C03 steps 1-2 (canonical schema + reference substrate: Skill schema, KB) executed; steps 3-5 (upstream format-parsing training, category-level holdout, cheaper-conditioning baseline under equal budget) not executed; hence C03 not assigned.
matches.success_failure_checks: No holdout of task categories, no contamination audit, no longer-context / nearest-neighbour baseline; ablation toggles the knowledge/Skill channel (Static, NoKnow).
matches.reason: Retrieval/conditioning without retraining is real, but the paper's evidence is mostly an ablation on its own benchmark.

matches.tactic_steps_checked: Typed JSON LoadDataSchema executed against real data sources with error-driven regeneration (steps 2-3) present; no ablation vs undecomposed monolithic agent, no cost accounting (steps 4-5).
matches.success_failure_checks: Matches 'verifiable intermediate artifact' condition for the schema; fails 'ablate decomposition vs unified baseline' and 'report cost' checks.
matches.reason: Three-agent matrix and Skill schema is decomposition with a checked artifact, but the verifier checks fields returned, not diagnostic correctness.

matches.condition_checks: Attribution of failure to LoadDataSchema vs Prompt vs knowledge content (S1 partial); no defect-vs-lapse split, no re-run on attributed cases, no disjoint validation before retaining an edit (S3 unmet).
Living knowledge store with daily dedupe/prune (S4 partial); no explicit edit-op vocabulary, no curator ablation, no leakage guard (F-checks unknown).

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Retrieved cases/knowledge conditioned into the prompt at inference <-> domain store that is written from outcomes and re-read later.
pattern_mapping.conditions_differences: RS card stresses holdout/format learning; domain H01 stresses curated edits and a gate. Paper satisfies neither gate nor holdout fully.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Schema-checked artifact + error-driven regeneration <-> patch the incumbent Skill on diagnosed retrieval defect.
pattern_mapping.conditions_differences: H11 requires re-validation on attributed cases and disjoint validation; only schema-executability is checked.

Question: does the retention rule protect earlier wins (rollback/regression check)? Only schema executability is gated; no replay on older cases, no rollback.

Static and NoKnow ablations toggle the Skill/knowledge channel on one benchmark; no matched multitask or same-budget comparison.
No comparison against feeding all signals, longer context or nearest-neighbour retrieval.
Error analysis names KB coverage for new services as main failure, but no sensitivity study.
No tokens/calls/latency per event or for generation/update loops.
No comparison with a single-agent/all-signals baseline or with RCAgent.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: In a 13-day production A/B (figure-only), enabling practitioner-feedback-driven Skill/knowledge updates kept RCA accuracy >80% versus decay to ~32% when frozen; LLM-generated Skills beat hand-written ones on a 104-event author set (pass@5 94.2 vs 83.7). Level retained is weak: no n/interval, and supervision is human.
assessment.unresolved: Co-evolution compounding; contribution of the self-evolving part to the 75% alert reduction; knowledge-base leakage into the offline set; autonomy without human feedback; improver level not shown.

G.reason: Real, specific bottleneck (event-specific context assembly and drifting mapping) with author evidence of decay when frozen, but no comparison with an all-signals baseline and nearest neighbours (RCAgent, skill/memory-evolving agents) are cited not contrasted.

M.reason: Mechanism is concrete (Skill = data schema + prompt, feedback routed to schema/prompt/knowledge) and plausible, but root-cause routing procedure and why the two-pathway coupling should beat single pathways are not articulated with distinguishable predictions.

X.reason: Main steps described (generate, validate-retry, update, daily consolidation, keyword read path). Missing: regression check or rollback for Skill edits, admission gate for knowledge, conflict handling beyond daily prune, versioning semantics.

E.measurement.reason: Production KPIs and SRE ground truth are meaningful, but RCA accuracy is practitioner-confirmed without definition/agreement, pass@k is lenient, and no recall check for suppressed alerts or trivial-baseline comparison.

E.causality.reason: Static and NoKnow ablations plus a 13-day on/off arm give relevant store-off style contrasts; but online KPIs are pre/post, co-evolution is unmeasured, manual-Skill baseline provenance unstated, and no alternative context-assembly baseline.

E.holdout.reason: Offline set serves for generation, retries, SRE corrections and ablations (selection=test); KB state before offline runs unspecified. Only the 13-day temporal stream is a quasi-holdout and is figure-only.

E.statistics.reason: Counts with denominators for pass@k (n=104, 44, 60, 36) but no intervals, seeds or variance; online figure has no uncertainty.

E.cost.reason: Hardware/backbone stated and a small backbone sweep (Table 8) exists, but no per-event token/call cost, cost of generation/update/retry loops, or budget-matched baselines.

rationale: 运维场景下 Skill/知识库随人工反馈更新并复用；13天开关对照有价值但仅图示，离线集同时用于选择与测试，协同演化未测，故中等偏下。
